title: CEDRIC Webinar: Soil Health & Biodiversity Introduction
reason: Provides an overview of the CEDRIC project and discusses sustainability in agriculture through life cycle assessment.

tasks.task: Introduce the CEDRIC project and its objectives.

subtasks.text: Explain the CEDRIC project's goal to strengthen microbiological biodiversity in soils.
Outline the main aspects of the CEDRIC project, including platforms for stakeholders and training programs.

tasks.task: Discuss the seminar topic and the background of Lucrezia Lamastra's research.

subtasks.text: Present the definition of sustainable agriculture provided by FAO.
Explain the five key principles of sustainability for food and agriculture.
Introduce the concept of planetary boundaries and their current status.
Explain the difference between mitigation and adaptation in addressing climate change.
Discuss the contribution of agriculture to global greenhouse gas emissions and the broader impact of the agri-food system.
Introduce global warming potential and its use in life cycle assessment.
Explain the concept of life cycle assessment and its importance in measuring sustainability.
Present the VIVA framework for assessing sustainability in the wine sector.
Discuss the methodology used in the life cycle assessment of milk production, including farm types and results.
Describe the potential for ecosystem services in agriculture and the limitations of current models.
Explain the role of carbon farming and carbon storage in addressing sustainability.
